LanguageData.YJZ_InheritanceBody:
The knowledge within the scroll rushes into your mind. Though most of it remains beyond your understanding, you dimly sense a path unfolding before you—a path beyond mortality and into transcendence.
At the same moment, the gloom hanging over the mausoleum lifts. The entire sanctuary bows before you. Its ancient seals, silent for ages, rejoice as you inherit the immortal name of Yunjianzi.
From this moment on, you are Thea Yunjianzi Anastasia.
